audiobookshelf.name: Audiobookshelf (audiobooks from a server)
audiobookshelf.description: Plays the audiobooks of an Audiobookshelf server on the box, streamed or downloaded, and shares the listening position with the Audiobookshelf apps.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.help: Create one in Audiobookshelf under Settings, API Keys, for the user the box should use. Leave empty to keep the current one.

refresh_minutes.label: Ask for new books every (minutes)
refresh_minutes.help: The position is always read fresh.

prefer_downloaded.label: Play downloaded books from the box
prefer_downloaded.help: Even when the server is reachable.
